name: 磁盘IO监控与瓶颈诊断
description: 磁盘 IO 是 MySQL 性能的核心瓶颈之一。诊断 IO 问题需要结合 OS 层（iostat、iotop）和 MySQL 层（performance_schema.file_summary、Innodb_buffer_pool_reads、Innodb_data_reads）两个维度。关键指标包括：IOPS（每秒读写次数）、吞吐量（MB/s）、IO 延迟（await/svctm）、IO 利用率（%util）。SSD/NVMe 与 HDD 的性能特征差异很大，阈值判断需要区分。

signals.desc: 物理读速率持续升高，大量请求穿透到磁盘

skip_when.desc: 正在执行备份（xtrabackup/mysqldump），IO 升高是预期行为
正在执行大批量数据导入
buffer pool 正在预热（实例刚启动）

root_causes.name: Buffer Pool 不足导致大量物理读
root_causes.desc: innodb_buffer_pool_size 过小，活跃数据无法全部缓存，导致频繁磁盘读。Innodb_buffer_pool_reads 速率持续 > 100/s 是明确信号。OLTP 系统 buffer pool 应覆盖 80%+ 活跃数据。

root_causes.name: 慢查询全表扫描导致大量读 IO
root_causes.desc: 未走索引的查询扫描大量数据页，产生大量顺序读 IO。iostat 中 rkB/s 很高但 r/s 不高的特征是大块顺序读。这些查询既消耗 IO 又污染 buffer pool。

root_causes.name: 写 IO 瓶颈（redo log / binlog / 刷脏页）
root_causes.desc: InnoDB 的写路径包括：redo log 写入（顺序写）、binlog 写入（顺序写）、脏页刷写（随机写）。sync_binlog=1 + innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit=1（双一配置）保证数据安全但增加 fsync 次数。NVMe 下影响较小，HDD 上影响显著。

root_causes.name: 磁盘硬件或文件系统瓶颈
root_causes.desc: 磁盘本身性能不足（如 HDD 做高并发随机 IO）、RAID 卡缓存用尽、文件系统碎片严重、或 NUMA 配置不当导致 IO 路径跨节点。iostat 中 svctm 持续 > 5ms（SSD）是硬件层面的信号。

step1_innodb_io_status.desc: InnoDB IO 相关状态变量
step1_innodb_io_status.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_buffer_pool_reads', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests', 'Innodb_data_reads', 'Innodb_data_writes', 'Innodb_data_fsyncs', 'Innodb_data_read', 'Innodb_data_written', 'Innodb_os_log_fsyncs', 'Innodb_os_log_written', 'Innodb_pages_read', 'Innodb_pages_written', 'Innodb_dblwr_writes', 'Innodb_dblwr_pages_written')

step2_file_io_summary.desc: 按文件查看 IO 统计
step2_file_io_summary.sql: SELECT FILE_NAME, COUNT_STAR, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 2) AS total_wait_sec, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/GREATEST(COUNT_STAR,1)/1e9, 2) AS avg_wait_ms, COUNT_READ, COUNT_WRITE, ROUND(SUM_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_READ/1024/1024, 1) AS read_mb, ROUND(SUM_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_WRITE/1024/1024, 1) AS write_mb FROM performance_schema.file_summary_by_instance ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 20

step3_file_io_by_type.desc: 按 IO 事件类型统计
step3_file_io_by_type.sql: SELECT EVENT_NAME, COUNT_STAR, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 2) AS total_sec, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1e9, 2) AS avg_ms FROM performance_schema.file_summary_by_event_name WHERE COUNT_STAR > 0 ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 20

step4_io_config.desc: 检查 IO 相关配置
step4_io_config.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit', 'sync_binlog', 'innodb_io_capacity', 'innodb_io_capacity_max', 'innodb_flush_method', 'innodb_doublewrite', 'innodb_read_io_threads', 'innodb_write_io_threads', 'innodb_page_cleaners', 'innodb_flush_neighbors')

step5_sys_io_latency.desc: 使用 sys schema 查看 IO 延迟分布

step6_pending_io.desc: 检查 InnoDB 待处理 IO 操作
step6_pending_io.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME LIKE 'Innodb_data_pending_%' OR VARIABLE_NAME LIKE 'Innodb_os_log_pending_%'

steps.action: 快速确认 MySQL 层 IO 状况
steps.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_buffer_pool_reads', 'Innodb_data_fsyncs', 'Innodb_data_pending_reads', 'Innodb_data_pending_writes', 'Innodb_os_log_pending_fsyncs')

steps.action: 检查是否有大查询正在做全表扫描
steps.sql: SELECT id, user, time, state, SUBSTRING(info,1,200) FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE command='Query' AND time > 10 AND state LIKE '%Sending%' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10

steps.action: 检查是否有备份或大批量操作在进行
steps.sql: SELECT id, user, time, info FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE user IN ('xtrabackup', 'backup') OR info LIKE '%INTO OUTFILE%' OR info LIKE '%LOAD DATA%'

steps.action: 临时降低后台 IO 消耗（降低脏页刷写速率）
steps.sql: SET GLOBAL innodb_io_capacity = 100; SET GLOBAL innodb_io_capacity_max = 200
steps.risk: 脏页可能堆积，需要后续恢复
steps.note: 让更多 IO 带宽给前台查询

version_specific_notes.5.7: innodb_flush_method 默认 fsync（Linux）。innodb_flush_neighbors=1 默认开启（HDD 优化，SSD 应设为 0）。file_summary_by_instance 提供文件级 IO 统计
version_specific_notes.8.0: innodb_flush_neighbors 默认改为 0（适应 SSD）。innodb_io_capacity 默认仍为 200（建议 SSD 调高到 2000+）。新增 innodb_log_writer_threads 优化 redo log 写入并行度
version_specific_notes.8.4: redo log 架构重写，写入性能提升。innodb_doublewrite 支持更多选项（DETECT_AND_RECOVER/DETECT_ONLY）。IO 调度更智能

real_world_examples.scenario: HDD 上 innodb_io_capacity 保持默认 200 导致脏页堆积
real_world_examples.symptoms: checkpoint 延迟增大，偶发查询卡顿。iostat %util=100% 持续
real_world_examples.root_cause: innodb_io_capacity=200 适合 HDD，但实际磁盘是 RAID10 HDD 阵列，IOPS 能力约 800
real_world_examples.result: 脏页刷写更平滑，查询卡顿消除

real_world_examples.scenario: NVMe SSD 上 innodb_flush_neighbors=1 导致不必要的额外写
real_world_examples.symptoms: NVMe 写放大，实际写入量是理论值的 1.5 倍
real_world_examples.root_cause: innodb_flush_neighbors=1 在 SSD 上会写入相邻脏页，增加不必要的写 IO
real_world_examples.result: 写 IO 量下降 30%，写延迟改善
